items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: played command performances two or three times for the Queen of England and all that royalty stuff.

ctx.x: I went back to New York with them at the end of '45, when I got out of service. I left Eddie Hayward in April, 1946, came back home and I stayed home without leaving until I went with the Basie Band in January of '51. I didn't want to go nowhere. But after I left with the Basie Band, I never set down anymore until 1970. It was all go. We entertained,
played command performances two or three times for the Queen of England and all that royalty stuff.
Did the Queen seem to enjoy the music?
